---
title: "How fast is the effective scale of frontier models growing?"
claim: "The effective scale of frontier models has been growing at around 15X per year."
---

**Short answer.** The effective scale of frontier models has been growing at around 15X per year.

The effective scale of frontier models takes into account both the increase in training compute used as well as the algorthmic efficiency in utilizing each unit of compute.

- [Epoch AI](https://epochai.org/trends) (Jan 2025) estimate that over 2015-2025:
  1. Training compute on frontier LLMs has increased around 5X per year; 
  2. Algorithmic efficiency increased around 3X per year. 
  - Combined, these imply that the “effective” compute used on frontier models is growing at around 15X per year.
